title: Richard, a whoreson crookback, misbegotten, makes love to a widowed Ann
html_source:
Richard III married Anne Neville after the death of Anne’s first husband Edward of Winchester, who was Richard III’s nephew. This is depicted in Act I, Scene 2 of Shakespeare’s Richard III.

Stephen sees a parallel between this Richard and Ann(e) and Richard Shakespeare and Anne Hathaway.
